Description

The two scientific satellites of Golden Bauhinia No. 3/4 are 3U nano-satellites customized by Hangsheng Satellite according to customer needs. They mainly complete the on-orbit verification of chip and micro-optical remote sensing technology, low price and short period of significant cost-effective advantages.
